courses.title: Individual Sound Healing and Private Sound Baths
courses.description: One-to-one sessions with Kristof at his practice in Brecht: a 75-minute sound massage with singing bowls and tuning forks placed on or near the body, or a private or duo sound bath of 75 or 120 minutes, which can also be held online. Both are offered as a way to release tension, rest deeply and meditate.
courses.price: Sound massage €75; sound bath €75 (75 min) or €120 (120 min), duo €130 or €190

left_out: Insight Timer courses 'Hyperventilation Relief' and 'The Power Of Sound: Relieve Stress And Soothe Anxiety': Insight Timer is never fetched, so I could not check the course pages; the titles themselves would pass the new rule. Sound massage and private/duo sound bath are two offers on the same page; entered as one offering because item URLs must be unique real pages.
flags: The page (in Dutch) lists muscle pain, local tension and 'chronische pijn of plaatselijke klachten' (chronic pain or local complaints) among what the sound massage suits; pain relief through practice, no disease named, so kept under the new rule.
